caption: The drawing is composed of six rectangular patterns arranged in two rows of three on a neutral, light beige background. The top left rectangle features a red background with a repeating arrangement of yellow, circular motifs with small black dots in between. The top center rectangle has a light gray background with diagonal lines creating a grid pattern, accented with small black dots and thin blue lines. The top right rectangle shows a red background patterned with black and white stylized leaves and buds connected by thin white dotted lines. The bottom left rectangle contains a white background with repeating black geometric motifs that resemble pixelated ovals. The bottom center rectangle has a deep brown background dotted with small red and pink floral motifs accompanied by tan leaves. The bottom right rectangle presents a white background with black leafy vines and small red dots distributed throughout. Each rectangular pattern is distinct in its color palette and design motif.
title: Materials from Quilt
